name: Taco Bell
notice: A layout study, not Taco Bell: its online food menu rebuilt with Golden Grids as GIFbell, a parody name. Not affiliated with Taco Bell; the order totals but is never sent, and prices vary by location.
summary: Taco Bell's online food menu, with its categories, its item pages and its box builder, rebuilt as one page of stacked golden grids in which a category is a ranking and an item's square opens into its customiser.

reviewed.method: Read in a desktop browser, because the site refuses automated capture. Categories, items, prices, calories, add-ons and box contents were copied down from the pages as shown for the site's sample store; colours and type were measured in the same session.

pages.label: An item page: Supreme Luxe Box

real: The menu's facts: categories, item names, prices, calories, what each item includes, the add-ons and their prices, and the boxes' components and swaps. Prices are one sample store's and vary by location.
The photographs show the actual menu items, taken by customers.
invented: The descriptions and section copy, which are the study's own words.
The order. It adds up, with a sample tax rate, and is never sent; nothing can be bought here.
Items with no freely licensed photograph are shown as type. None of the chain's photography, marks or copy is used.
The brand. GIFbell is a parody name made for this study; it is not a restaurant.
